subject: Vendor activation: data handling path, DPA, and PO finalization
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia@skylinepay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@skylinepay.com
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding — reqs for go-live and PO

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — were excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to confirm the set of security/privacy artifacts we need to provide to you so your team can enable us in the vendor portal and issue the PO. To avoid back-and-forth, heres what we have ready:

- Signed DPA (attached)
- SOC 2 summary + link to full report (hosted pdf link below)
- Current subprocessor list (attached PDF)
- Standard PO template — we can accept redlines, or you can send your PO first

A couple of questions for your team:
1) What PO number format should we use for invoice submission?
2) Any special routing codes for tax/invoice teams at Redwood?
3) Does Redwood require additional evidence (pen-tests, attestation emails) before activation?

Attached: SkylinePay-DPA-executed-2029-08.pdf, SkylinePay-Subprocessors-2029-07.pdf

SOC 2 report (full): https://docs.skylinepay.com/soc2-report-2029

Best,
Amelia Torres
Head of Partnerships | SkylinePay
Phone: +1 415-555-0191

[Attachment: SkylinePay-DPA-executed-2029-08.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: SkylinePay-Subprocessors-2029-07.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@skylinepay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — reqs for go-live and PO

Thanks Amelia — this is great and helps move things quickly. A few quick pieces from our side:

- PO routing / format: Redwood POs use prefix RDW-<vendor>-<seq>. For SkylinePay we will assign RDW-SKP-45123. Please reference that on invoices.
- Routing codes: finance will need Cost Center 4102 (Platform) and Dept code PROCPROC. Ill loop procurement to issue the PO formally.
- Evidence: your signed DPA and the SOC 2 link are sufficient for initial activation. For higher-sensitivity connectors we sometimes require SOC 2 SOC report vouch or pen-test summary; not required for standard invoicing integrations.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ill ask Procurement (Ben) to open a PO and share the draft as PDF for review.
2) You confirm the invoice remit details exactly as they appear on the PO.
3) Once PO is signed on our side and weve verified the subprocessor list, well flip the vendor to Active in the portal and schedule the tech handoff.

Looping Laura and Ben to take Procurement/PO forward.

—Jordan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (650) 555-0112

Subject: PO RDW-SKP-45123 draft + vendor bank remit confirmation

Hi team,

I created the PO draft RDW-SKP-45123 (attached). A couple of asks for SkylinePay to confirm so we can route for signature:

- Confirm legal name and W-9/Tax ID (exact text for the PO).
- Confirm bank remit instructions (we prefer ACH). If you prefer wire, please include SWIFT and intermediary bank info.
- Subprocessor question: we saw that DataLogix Inc. is listed as a subprocessor handling telemetry. Can you confirm whether telemetry logs include customer PII or are strictly system metrics?

Amelia — were aiming to have the PO signed internally by EOD Monday if we get the above details.

Attached: SkylinePay-PO-45123.pdf

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Ben, Jordan — thanks. Quick answers below and Ive attached a signed copy of the DPA for your records (again).

- Legal name / Tax ID for PO: Skyline Payments, Inc. / EIN 91-2345678
- Remit: ACH preferred. Bank details: Skyline Payments, Inc.; Routing 121000358; Account 987654321. (If wire required, use Bank of Pacific / SWIFT BOPACUS3XXX).
- Subprocessor "DataLogix Inc.": they ingest only anonymized telemetry (no customer PII). We audited their pipeline in June 2029; summary attached in the subprocessor PDF.

Ive also initiated DocuSign for the PO acceptance on our side: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/ABCD-1234-SKP

Let me know if you need anything else to get to Active in your portal.

Best,
Amelia
